verses.sanskrit:
वक्रतुण्ड महाकाय सूर्यकोटिसमप्रभ ।
निर्विघ्नं कुरु मे देव सर्वकार्येषु सर्वदा ॥
verses.translation: O Lord of the curved trunk and massive body, with the radiance of a million suns — please make all my endeavors free from obstacles at all times.

verses.sanskrit:
शुक्लाम्बरधरं विष्णुं शशिवर्णं चतुर्भुजम् ।
प्रसन्नवदनं ध्यायेत् सर्वविघ्नोपशान्तये ॥
verses.translation: For the removal of all obstacles, one should meditate upon the Lord who wears white garments, who is all-pervading, who is of moonlike complexion, who has four arms, and whose face is always serene.

verses.sanskrit:
अगजाननपद्मार्कं गजाननमहर्निशम् ।
अनेकदं तं भक्तानां एकदन्तमुपास्महे ॥
verses.translation: We worship the single-tusked one, who is the sun to the lotus face of Parvati, the elephant-faced one worshipped day and night, who bestows many boons upon his devotees.

verses.sanskrit:
गणानां त्वां गणपतिं हवामहे कविं कवीनामुपमश्रवस्तमम् ।
ज्येष्ठराजं ब्रह्मणां ब्रह्मणस्पत आ नः शृण्वन्नूतिभिः सीद सादनम् ॥
verses.translation: O Lord of the Ganas, we invoke You, O Ganapati, the seer among seers, most renowned, the eldest king among prayers. Hear our invocations and take your seat, bringing blessings.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रणम्य शिरसा देवं गौरीपुत्रं विनायकम् ।
भक्तावासं स्मरेन्नित्यं आयुःकामार्थसिद्धये ॥
verses.translation: Having bowed one's head to the divine Vinayaka, son of Gauri, who resides in the hearts of devotees — one should remember Him always for the attainment of long life, desires, and prosperity.
